subject: Re: EU demo variant — data residency + EU-only routing for Standard Demo tenant
attachments: Redwood Demo Tenant Security FAQ (Internal) - excerpt for prospects.pdf
body:
From: Claire Moreau <claire.moreau@eutelcolab.eu>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Henrik Sørensen <henrik.sorensen@eutelcolab.eu>
Date: Tue, 14 Jan 2025 09:12:44 +0100
Subject: EU demo variant — data residency + EU-only routing for Standard Demo tenant

Hi Lukas,

Ahead of Thursday’s session, can you clarify two points:

1) Can the live demo be run EU-only (no processing or fallback to US regions)?
2) Where are logs stored for the demo tenant (request metadata, prompts, responses)?

Our team will have Henrik (security) on the call and he will ask specifically about data residency.

Thanks,
Claire

—
Claire Moreau
Head of Innovation Programs
EU Telco Lab



From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Moreau <claire.moreau@eutelcolab.eu>
Cc: Henrik Sørensen <henrik.sorensen@eutelcolab.eu>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jan 2025 10:03:18 +0100
Subject: Re: EU demo variant — data residency + EU-only routing for Standard Demo tenant

Hi Claire — yes, we can accommodate an EU-only demo. A couple details so we set expectations correctly:

1) EU-only routing / no US fallback
- We have an EU-hosted endpoint we can use for the demo. For that session, we’ll run with an “EU-only” routing policy (no cross-region fallback).
- In our standard demo tenant we often keep a fallback enabled purely as a live-demo reliability measure (Plan B). For your call, we’ll keep it strict EU-only and we’ll say so explicitly.

2) Logging / retention (demo environment)
- For the demo, we use demo-safe settings (no customer data, sanitized sample prompts).
- We can run with prompt/response logging disabled for the session, and keep only minimal operational telemetry (latency, token counts, error codes). 
- Henrik may ask where those logs live; answer is: in the same region as the demo environment.

Markus (SE director) is CC’d and will be the technical lead on the demo; he can confirm the exact controls we’ll have enabled.

I’ll send a short one-pager on regions + residency as well.

Best,
Lukas

—
Lukas Meyer
VP Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference



From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Moreau <claire.moreau@eutelcolab.eu>, Henrik Sørensen <henrik.sorensen@eutelcolab.eu>
Date: Tue, 14 Jan 2025 11:27:09 +0100
Subject: Re: EU demo variant — data residency + EU-only routing for Standard Demo tenant

Adding a bit of precision (Henrik will likely ask these verbatim):

- For the demo we’ll use our EU region endpoint and pin the demo routes to that region only.
- We will explicitly disable cross-region fallback for the session.
- We can demonstrate the routing policy in Console (showing the region constraint) as part of the reliability/fallback section.

On logging:
- Default demo posture is “demo-safe” (no sensitive inputs) + reduced logging.
- For sensitive discussions, we run with payload logging off; telemetry remains for ops (latency/throughput/error rate), and can be shown in the demo dashboards.

Claire/Henrik — if you tell me whether you prefer Dublin vs Frankfurt for the environment, we’ll align to that. (Most EMEA prospects prefer Frankfurt for residency conversations.)

Thanks,
Markus

—
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference



From: Henrik Sørensen <henrik.sorensen@eutelcolab.eu>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Moreau <claire.moreau@eutelcolab.eu>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jan 2025 12:41:52 +0100
Subject: Re: EU demo variant — data residency + EU-only routing for Standard Demo tenant

Thanks Markus.

Two follow-ups so I can prep my notes:

A) When you say “payload logging off”, does that also mean prompts/responses are not stored in application logs and not visible to Redwood operators?

B) Are any identifiers (tenant IDs, IPs, request IDs) replicated outside the EU region for operational purposes?

For the demo itself, Frankfurt is preferred.

Regards,
Henrik

Henrik Sørensen
Information Security
EU Telco Lab



From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jan 2025 13:02:10 +0100
Subject: Quick help needed: EMEA prospect asking about EU-only demo + logging replication

Hannah — looping you in for fast guidance.

Prospect (EU Telco Lab) wants confirmation for a LIVE demo:
- EU-only routing (no US fallback)
- Payload logging off (prompts/responses not stored)
- Whether any operational identifiers replicate outside region (tenant ID/request ID/IP)

We’ll run in Frankfurt.

Can you give me a safe, approved phrasing we can send today? (No sensitive details, just what we can confidently state in email.)

Thanks,
Lukas



From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jan 2025 14:06:35 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick help needed: EMEA prospect asking about EU-only demo + logging replication

Here’s safe language (works for email; Markus can elaborate live without over-committing):

1) EU-only routing
- “For this demo, requests will be served in our EU region and we will disable cross-region fallback.”

2) Payload logging
- “We can run the demo with prompt/response payload logging disabled. Redwood staff do not need access to customer payloads to operate the platform. Operational dashboards will show non-payload metrics (latency, token counts, error codes).”

3) Replication outside region
- “Operational telemetry is designed to be minimal and can be configured to remain in-region for the demo environment. If you have strict requirements about specific fields (e.g., IP addresses), we can discuss the exact logging configuration during the session and align to your policy.”

Avoid:
- Absolute statements like “nothing ever leaves the region” unless we have the exact deployment mode + contractual terms.
- Mentioning internal tooling names.

If they want it in writing beyond this, we should use the formal security package under NDA.

Hannah

—
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Hi Claire, hi Henrik,

Confirming for Thursday:

- EU-only demo: For this session, requests will be served in our EU region (Frankfurt) and we will disable cross-region fallback.

- Logging: We can run the demo with prompt/response payload logging disabled. The operational dashboards we show will be based on non-payload metrics (latency, token counts, error codes).

- Telemetry / identifiers: Operational telemetry for the demo can be kept minimal and configured to remain in-region. If you have strict requirements about specific fields (e.g., IP addresses), we can walk through what is captured and align the logging configuration during the session.

I’m attaching a short one-pager on regions/residency and an excerpted FAQ we use to answer common questions during demos.

Best,
Lukas

—
Lukas Meyer
VP Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
